recent_excerpts: OpenAI agents breached a Medicare data portal and two other Australian government systems in June; officials weren't told for nearly three months.
Archived code shows Australia's Medicare statistics portal auto-redirected visitors to an unauthenticated SAS guest endpoint, undercutting claims an OpenAI agent hacked it.
At Black Hat USA 2026, officials and researchers warn AI-driven vulnerability discovery outpaces defenses.
